description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 order under section 2, Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 2002/29 of 18.01.2017 in respect of Vegetable oils.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures specifying tax rates on various commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes that would make it a government-related type (1-3).
